caveats: Held-out data was not used to retune rules or policies.
Oracle-assisted heuristic policies are skill/execution proxies, not calibrated humans.
Neutral forced-type controls vary policy and patch effects relative to expert; they are stress baselines, not clean patch-only causal ablations.
Fixed-board loot trials isolate the board, not downstream adaptive command schedules.
Failure to win in 40 seeds does not establish impossibility; 0/40 Wilson upper95% bound is about8.8%.
